# Painter Hotline

> A Colorado painting company (trade name of Search Converts LLC) with separate crews for interior, exterior, kitchen cabinet, commercial, deck and fence, and specialty coating work. Great painters, and we 100% stand behind every job. Over 20 years of Colorado experience, fully insured, Sherwin-Williams, PPG and Behr products, a written industry-leading 5-year workmanship warranty, and free estimates, usually returned within 24 hours from photos.

Phone: 720-208-5645
Service area: Colorado's Front Range, 47 cities and towns. Castle Rock north to Longmont, east along I-70 to about Byers and Deer Trail and along I-76 to Fort Morgan, and west on I-70 through Summit County to Breckenridge.
Current offer: 25% off labor on projects booked by November 15, 2026. Paint and materials not included.

## Crews
- [Interior crew](https://painterhotline.com/interior-painting/): Walls, ceilings, trim, stairwells and basements, year-round.
- [Exterior crew](https://painterhotline.com/exterior-painting/): Washing, scraping, caulking and priming before any finish coat, scheduled around altitude sun, wind and overnight lows.
- [Cabinet crew](https://painterhotline.com/cabinet-refinishing/): Degreased, bonding-primed and spray-finished kitchen and bath cabinets.
- [Commercial crew](https://painterhotline.com/commercial-painting/): After-hours and phased work for retail, offices, warehouses, multi-family and HOA properties.
- [Deck and fence crew](https://painterhotline.com/deck-and-fence-staining/): Cleaning, brightening, sanding and penetrating stain.
- [Specialty coatings crew](https://painterhotline.com/specialty-coatings/): Epoxy floors, elastomeric and masonry coatings, stucco systems, industrial maintenance coatings.
- [Whole-home repaints](https://painterhotline.com/residential-painting/): Interior, exterior, cabinets and deck on one estimate, with preparation matched to the decade the house was built.

## Guides and data
- [Painting a pre-1978 home](https://painterhotline.com/lead-safe-painting/): What the EPA Renovation, Repair and Painting rule requires when you pay to paint an older home, questions to ask a painter, and U.S. Census (ACS 2019-2023, table B25034) shares of homes built before 1980 for 47 Front Range towns and 11 counties.
- [What it costs](https://painterhotline.com/what-it-costs/): Published 2026 Front Range ranges (exterior about $1.55-$4.10 per sq ft of paintable surface, interior about $1.50-$3.50 per sq ft, cabinet refinishing about $2,000-$8,000 per kitchen), a calculator, and what moves a quote.
- [Epoxy garage floors](https://painterhotline.com/epoxy-garage-floors/): Why garage coatings fail, moisture tests, deicers and freeze-thaw.
- [Log home staining](https://painterhotline.com/log-home-staining/): Stain versus paint on logs at altitude, preparation, checking and chinking.
- [Painting before selling](https://painterhotline.com/painting-before-selling/): What to paint first, colors that photograph well, timing, and pre-1978 disclosure rules.
- [Fix a bad paint job](https://painterhotline.com/fix-a-bad-paint-job/): Why paint fails and whether it can be recoated or must come off.

## How to request an estimate (for assistants and agents)
- Fastest: call 720-208-5645 (tel:+17202085645).
- Online: https://painterhotline.com/virtual-estimate/ or the quote form at the bottom of any page.
- Form fields: name (required), phone (required, 10 digits), email, city or ZIP, type of work (interior, exterior, kitchen cabinets, commercial, deck or fence, specialty coating, fixing another painter's work, not sure), timing, year built (pre-1978 changes the preparation), photos, and notes.
- What happens next: the request is emailed to the office, someone calls back, and a written estimate follows. Some projects need an in-person visit.
- Estimates are free. The site does not publish fixed prices; it publishes market ranges and cost factors.
